about: Made-up situations for designing and testing a Lane 1 tool. No scenario describes a real person, property or organization. Parcel facts are deliberately missing: your tool should find them from public data, or say 'unknown'.

scenarios.title: A congregation with a parking lot
scenarios.who: The facilities chair of a small congregation in an Orange County city. The lot is half-empty except on weekends.
scenarios.in_their_words: We keep hearing churches can build housing now. Can we? Where would we even start?
scenarios.what_good_looks_like: Which pathway might apply (likely SB 4), what to check about the parcel, and which facts are unknown until someone confirms them.

scenarios.title: An acquisitions lead with no GIS team
scenarios.who: A one-person acquisitions team at a small housing nonprofit.
scenarios.in_their_words: Give me ten sites in one city I should call about this month, and why each one.
scenarios.what_good_looks_like: A short, ranked list with the law that opens each site, the data behind it, and what still has to be checked (ownership, hazards, utilities).

scenarios.title: A legal site that may not be usable
scenarios.who: City housing staff reviewing a list of candidate sites.
scenarios.in_their_words: Half the sites on these lists turn out to be on a slope or in a fire zone. Can you flag those first?
scenarios.what_good_looks_like: Hazard and constraint checks (fire, flood, slope, contamination) shown next to each site, with sources and dates.
